description_target.target_text: replicate marker to same-parity cells in lattice grid

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Line color is the most frequent non-zero color
         (line-color
          (let* ((freq (make-hash))
                 (_ (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                      (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                        (when (not (= v 0))
                          (hash-set! freq v (+ 1 (hash-ref freq v 0)))))))
                 (best -1)
                 (best-color 0))
            (hash-for-each freq
              (lambda (k v)
                (when (> v best)
                  (set! best v)
                  (set! best-color k))))
            best-color))
         ;; Line rows: rows where all cells equal line-color
         (line-rows
          (for/list ((r (range 0 h))
                     #:when (for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                              (= (cell-at g r c) line-color)))
            r))
         (line-cols
          (for/list ((c (range 0 w))
                     #:when (for/and ((r (range 0 h)))
                              (= (cell-at g r c) line-color)))
            c))
         ;; Cell row ranges (between lines, plus before first and after last)
         (row-bounds (append (list -1) line-rows (list h)))
         (col-bounds (append (list -1) line-cols (list w)))
         (cell-row-ranges
          (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
            (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length row-bounds) 1))))
              (list (+ 1 (list-ref row-bounds i))
                    (- (list-ref row-bounds (+ i 1)) 1)))))
         (cell-col-ranges
          (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
            (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length col-bounds) 1))))
              (list (+ 1 (list-ref col-bounds i))
                    (- (list-ref col-bounds (+ i 1)) 1)))))
         ;; Find marker cell and pattern
         (n-cr (length cell-row-ranges))
         (n-cc (length cell-col-ranges))
         (marker-info
          (let loop ((cr 0) (cc 0) (m-cr -1) (m-cc -1) (m-pat '()))
            (cond
              ((>= cr n-cr) (list m-cr m-cc m-pat))
              ((>= cc n-cc) (loop (+ cr 1) 0 m-cr m-cc m-pat))
              (else
               (let* ((range-r (list-ref cell-row-ranges cr))
                      (range-c (list-ref cell-col-ranges cc))
                      (r1 (first range-r)) (r2 (second range-r))
                      (c1 (first range-c)) (c2 (second range-c))
                      (pat
                       (for*/list ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
                                   (c (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                   #:when (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                                            (and (not (= v 0))
                                                 (not (= v line-color)))))
                         (list (- r r1) (- c c1) (cell-at g r c)))))
                 (if (null? pat)
                     (loop cr (+ cc 1) m-cr m-cc m-pat)
                     (loop cr (+ cc 1) cr cc pat)))))))
         (marker-cr (first marker-info))
         (marker-cc (second marker-info))
         (marker-pat (third marker-info)))
    (for*/fold ((out g))
               ((cr (range 0 n-cr))
                (cc (range 0 n-cc))
                #:when (and (= (modulo cr 2) (modulo marker-cr 2))
                            (= (modulo cc 2) (modulo marker-cc 2))))
      (let* ((range-r (list-ref cell-row-ranges cr))
             (range-c (list-ref cell-col-ranges cc))
             (r1 (first range-r)) (r2 (second range-r))
             (c1 (first range-c)) (c2 (second range-c)))
        (for/fold ((gg out)) ((p marker-pat))
          (let ((rr (+ r1 (first p)))
                (cc2 (+ c1 (second p)))
                (v (third p)))
            (if (and (<= rr r2) (<= cc2 c2))
                (set-cell gg rr cc2 v)
                gg))))))))
racket_target.target_code:
(rule!
 ;; Full lines of the dominant color rule the board into lattice cells.
 ;; One cell (the last in scan order holding anything) carries a marker
 ;; pattern: stamp that pattern into every cell sharing its row AND
 ;; column parity, clipped to each cell.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define line-color
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
                         (remove-duplicates
                          (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                               (grid-positions g))))
                 (lambda (v) (length (find-color g v)))))
     (define row-bounds
       (append (list -1)
               (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c)
                                                        line-color))
                                         (range 0 w)))
                       (range 0 h))
               (list h)))
     (define col-bounds
       (append (list -1)
               (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c)
                                                        line-color))
                                         (range 0 h)))
                       (range 0 w))
               (list w)))
     (define (spans bounds)
       (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
               (map (lambda (i) (list (+ 1 (nth bounds i))
                                      (- (nth bounds (+ i 1)) 1)))
                    (range 0 (- (length bounds) 1)))))
     (define row-spans (spans row-bounds))
     (define col-spans (spans col-bounds))
     (define (pattern-at cr cc)  ;; non-line cells relative to the cell
       (let ((rr (nth row-spans cr)) (cs (nth col-spans cc)))
         (for*/list ((r (range (first rr) (+ (second rr) 1)))
                     (c (range (first cs) (+ (second cs) 1)))
                     #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                              (and (not (= v 0))
                                   (not (= v line-color)))))
           (list (- r (first rr)) (- c (first cs)) (at g r c)))))
     (define marker  ;; LAST populated cell in scan order: (cr cc pat)
       (for*/fold ((best (list -1 -1 (list))))
                  ((cr (range 0 (length row-spans)))
                   (cc (range 0 (length col-spans))))
         (let ((pat (pattern-at cr cc)))
           (if (null? pat) best (list cr cc pat)))))
     (for*/fold ((out g))
                ((cr (range 0 (length row-spans)))
                 (cc (range 0 (length col-spans)))
                 #:when (and (= (modulo cr 2) (modulo (first marker) 2))
                             (= (modulo cc 2)
                                (modulo (second marker) 2))))
       (let ((rr (nth row-spans cr)) (cs (nth col-spans cc)))
         (for/fold ((gg out)) ((p (third marker)))
           (let ((r2 (+ (first rr) (first p)))
                 (c2 (+ (first cs) (second p))))
             (if (and (<= r2 (second rr)) (<= c2 (second cs)))
                 (set-cell gg r2 c2 (third p))
                 gg))))))))
